hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.jsx|*.css) out=$(node scripts/governance-check.js "$f" --quiet 2>&1) || printf '%s' "$out" | jq -Rs '{systemMessage:"governance-check: violaciones de .agents/rules/", hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse", additionalContext:.}}';; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
